question: How do we protect workers through the disruption before the gains arrive?
reflection: Every leap in productivity is a chance to invest in people, not only in machines.

sources.subject: Claude Meetings joins Google Meet live, builds docs in real time

one_line: AI agents are moving inside organisations' own systems, while central bankers warn that workers may feel the disruption before the gains.

top_stories.title: Claude agents can now run on a company's own cloud
top_stories.what: Anthropic opened a private beta of self-hosted Claude Managed Agents, where the agent server, data, credentials and sandboxes stay in the customer's environment.
top_stories.why: Keeping agents and their records in-house is what many public bodies need before they can let AI touch internal systems.

top_stories.title: A Fed governor warns of short-term AI job pain
top_stories.what: Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr said societies should prepare for serious labour disruption from AI before productivity gains arrive, as consulting firms test pricing by outcome instead of hours.
top_stories.why: Labour-market and workforce studies on AI exposure, retraining and the junior-role squeeze are becoming urgent policy work.

top_stories.title: Nvidia's founder steps down
top_stories.what: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia's CEO and left the board, with finance chief Colette Kress serving as interim CEO, raising questions about Nvidia's support for open models.
top_stories.why: Many free models used by smaller teams came from Nvidia, so a strategy change could narrow open options.

saudi_lens.text: Self-hosted agents fit Saudi rules that keep sensitive government data inside the Kingdom, so they may reach public-sector pilots sooner than cloud-only tools.
The warning about early job disruption matters for Saudization goals, since entry-level office roles are both a target for local hiring and the easiest to automate.

idea.title: Junior roles exposure map
idea.pitch: Map which entry-level tasks in a sector are most exposed to AI agents and test which retraining messages persuade young workers to move into new roles.
idea.first_step: List ten common graduate job titles and score each task in them for how easily an AI agent could do it.

Anthropic reportedly grew revenue over 1,200% year on year, to $33.2 billion in nine months.

terms.definition: Software that runs on an organisation's own servers or cloud account, so its data does not pass through the vendor's systems.
A sealed-off space where an AI agent can run code or try actions without being able to harm other systems.
Charging for results delivered instead of for hours worked, a model AI is pushing consultancies toward.

concepts.summary: Keeping data and AI processing inside national borders and under national rules.
AI changing which jobs exist and how fast, with entry-level roles hit first.
AI agents that work inside Teams, Slack and meetings as shared team members.
Freely available models backed by chipmakers and labs, which smaller teams rely on.
